fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' fires a massive arrow of ice in the target direction, briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} it flies through. The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|1 to 1 for 5;1 to 3.5 for 10|0 to 2800|formula=1s for the first 800 units traveled; 1+(0.25 per 200 units)s beyond 800 units. ''This is capped at 2800 units traveled.''}} seconds, and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them for 1 second.
fields.description2: Enemies surrounding the primary target are dealt the same damage and afflicted with ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}''.
fields.notes:
* ''Enchanted Crystal Arrow's'' projectile has an [[File:Enchanted Crystal Arrow Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Ashe''' and her allies.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* The effect will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.
